svg.title: Two maps of the same country
svg.desc: Two maps of Finnish counties in 2024: five-year bowel cancer survival and breast screening attendance, each against the national value.
svg.text: Where a county is behind Finland, 2024
Left: outcome. Right: detection. A county can be behind in one and not in the other.
Finland: 68%. Each value covers ten years of diagnoses.
Finland: 81.6% of the women invited. The strategy asks for 80% in every county.
Data: THL Sotkanet, indicators 3627 and 3621, cached in pathway-watch/data/raw/. Map: Statistics Finland. Åland is left out.
